config.source: US Treasury market, business daily, via FRED: 2-, 10- and 30-year constant-maturity yields (DGS2, DGS10, DGS30), the 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) and the New York Fed's ACM 10-year term premium (THREEFYTP10)
config.note: Percent a year at the close, full dates kept. The term premium is a model estimate (Adrian, Crump and Moench) of the part of the 10-year yield that is not expected short rates; it is revised as the model is re-estimated and can be negative. The real yield is the TIPS yield, so 10-year minus real is the market's inflation compensation, not a survey expectation. Resample with frequency='annual_mean' before mixing with monthly data
